name: Owers' Corner
objection: Mainly a trailhead and a short stop; could be argued as part of the track, and a visit without the walk is rare.

name: Bomana War Cemetery
objection: One counted source and it lies in Port Moresby, so it is a memorial more than an outdoor attraction; the objection is only weak sourcing, not the bar.

name: Ioribaiwa Ridge
objection: For: named battlefield and a realistic short trek for visitors not doing the full track. Against: it is a ridge on the track itself and only a single, passing mention.

name: Brigade Hill
objection: For: one of the few named memorial sites on the track. Against: only reachable as part of the multi-day walk, so part of the track; one source.

name: Isurava
objection: On the track, so could be part of the walk; and one counted source with the museum often shut.

name: Mount Lamington
objection: For: well-known landmark with a visitor page of its own and a strong story. Against: no defined visit, the Higaturu site needs landowner arrangement, and the memorials are in Popondetta.

name: Tufi Fjords
objection: Could be a near-duplicate of Tufi itself; but Tufi is the town, the fjords are the scenery people come for.

name: Cyclone Reef
objection: For: the named reef of Tufi diving. Against: reachable only by operator dive boat, one source, no coordinates; the place is the reef but practically a dive trip.

name: Cape Nelson
objection: For: tourism board names it for cultural and reef visits. Against: it is a peninsula/region that Tufi covers; no distinct point to stand at.

name: Buna
objection: One counted source; a coastal village whose relics are not signposted; the memorial plaque is minor.

name: Gona
objection: Thinner than Buna; and the tourism listing is a single bullet, so it could be review.
